## Service 1: Voice Search Optimization (VSO)

**Headline**
Own “Position Zero” and dominate voice answers before competitors even see the query.

**Outcome Promise**
Capture high-intent voice traffic from Google Assistant, Siri, Alexa, and AI answer engines within 60–90 days.

**Ideal Client**
Local service brands, real estate developers, travel agencies, clinics, and e-commerce brands with location-based or intent-heavy queries.

**Default Entry Tier**
Tactical – $1,250/month

**Primary Upsell Path**
Strategic VSO → GEO & AI Search Domination

**Objection Killer**
“Voice search traffic converts 3.2× higher than text because users ask when they’re ready to act.”
